patterns.what_worked: The H-1 fix needed TWO independent defences to be provable: the hits-only median AND a best-hit floor, so a single-line mutant that restores either one is still caught by a pin. Reading the sibling lanes' in-flight edits (practice_ui.lua 11:48, practice_progress_ui.lua 11:50) before filing the call-site diffs kept the filed line numbers exact.
patterns.what_was_hard: The 'cap can be zero' mutant I wrote first was an EQUIVALENT mutant (the points > 0 filter already dropped the misses) and SURVIVED - the two defences had to be understood before the proof meant anything. Separately, the harness carried 1-3 failures from a parallel hunter lane editing classes/hunter.lua mid-run; proving those suites never load the two pure modules was what made the crossfire verdict checkable rather than assumed.
patterns.skill_gap: Judge a mutation's SEMANTIC effect before trusting it as a proof; a surviving mutant may be an equivalent mutant rather than a hole in the pins, and the difference needs the implementation in front of you, not the test names.
